meta.name: Minerva Academy
meta.description:
At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: The Smallsword
videos.overview: New cadets arrive at Military High School. As Salvo looks for clues about a missing friend, rivalries, crushes and power dynamics quickly erupt.

videos.title: The Circuit
videos.overview: The recruits must face a brutal circuit to earn leave. Salvo makes a daring move in his investigation, while Camilla confronts her own fears.

videos.title: The Theft
videos.overview: A stolen exam sends Minerva into lockdown. Salvo becomes an easy target for the seniors and Camilla takes a big risk. Rachele senses something's wrong.

videos.title: The Leave
videos.overview: During a night out, Salvo is dragged into his mother's old schemes. Camilla throws a birthday party, where Diego and Vincenzo cross new lines.

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: At a fencing tournament, Salvo follows a new lead while Vincenzo considers leaving Minerva. Rachele pushes past her weaknesses and doesn't give up.

videos.title: The War
videos.overview: War games turn personal when a cadet brings a loaded gun. As Salvo confronts Max, Diego unravels and Rachele opens up to Pietro.

videos.title: The Mak P
videos.overview: Evidence tied to Francesco exposes senior cadets, forcing Salvo to shake the school to its core in search of the truth, while Diego and Max refuse to face it.

videos.title: The Ball
videos.overview: As Minerva faces the consequences of its secrets and abuse of power, Salvo gets his answers, Diego confronts his past and Camilla chooses her own path.
